about_short_description.short_description: Laserfocus helps streamline sales processes to help increase sales productivity.

product.name: Laserfocus Salesforce Interface
product.description: A unified interface that consolidates tasks, emails, events, notes, and Salesforce updates to streamline sales activities within one platform.

product.name: Full Cycle Sales System
product.description: A system that consolidates all sales tools and deal information into one view, enabling direct communication and updates without switching platforms.

product.name: Sales Process Guidance
product.description: A feature that provides step-by-step guidelines for each stage of the sales process to ensure no steps are missed.

product.name: Salesforce Data Management and Cleanup
product.description: A service that removes duplicate fields and ambiguous data in Salesforce to maintain data consistency and a streamlined user interface.

product.name: Change Management for Go-To-Market Processes
product.description: A feature that helps teams adapt to evolving business requirements by guiding users through updated sales processes and workflows.
